items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: so I went to La Conga, to Jack Harris, to visit him.

ctx.x: Sacasas send me a telegram that he going to be another four weeks because his mother, the aunt or whatever and he got fed-up with the independence of, you know the owners are, and he liked what we were doing, because he was a musician. We couldn't fool the guy, a tremendous violin player, so he liked the band, so we played that particular time and Lopez had a contract for me for six weeks because

he gave it two-weeks notice to the band that he has, So I had the contract in my pocket and I went to Lopez and Lopez said: "no because - come tomorrow to sign the papers because" so and so and so, you know. I feel like so kind of leary about it - that he was hesitant to sign - so I went to La Conga, to Jack Harris, to visit him. He said: "Well, what you have in mind"? I said: "well, we like to work here." So "No, I have Noro Morales. But don't worry. One day, I'll get you. So Noro Morales was a soft-touch…

Before we play La Conga, we played the Beachcomber, where the Hawaii Kai is, and we were the talk of the town. Diosa used to go out there everyday and then she married with Pupi Campo and we, we got together. She helped me tremendously.
